name: popkit/popkit
description: Accessible, lean popups for WordPress. Modal and inline banner, built for speed and screen readers.

scripts-descriptions.lint: Check PHP against the WordPress Coding Standards ruleset in phpcs.xml.dist.
scripts-descriptions.lint:fix: Auto-fix the PHPCS violations that are safely fixable.
scripts-descriptions.test: Run the unit suite, then the integration suite. The integration suite needs WordPress (wp-env or WP_TESTS_DIR).
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Run the pure-logic suite. Needs no WordPress, no database and no Docker.
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Run the WordPress integration suite. Requires WP_TESTS_DIR or WP_PHPUNIT__DIR.
